findings: Fine branched herb with deeply divided leaves and tiny paired pink flowers. Dedicated geranium staged; reddish stems remain current palette limitation. Current seeds 1, 4 and 7 and every panel in the 36-seed contact sheet were visually inspected. Divided leaf structures and paired small pink flowers now follow branching stems. The 20–40 cm forms vary colony openness. Compact seed foliage still merges at 25 mm, fine divisions and reddish stems remain appearance limitations; retain physical size. Accepted as a coarse stylized spring source at 25 mm; user endorsement remains separate.
